name: Noventra | Automatic BNM PDF Ingestion v1.0 | Phase 3

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({model:'gpt-4o-mini',temperature:0,response_format:{type:'json_object'},messages:[{role:'system',content:'You extract regulatory clauses from Bank Negara Malaysia documents. Return one JSON object with a clauses array only. Extract every numbered regulatory clause. Each clause must contain clause_number, clause_title, section_reference, page_start, page_end, classification (S, G, or unclassified), requirement_text, guidance_text, extraction_confidence from 0 to 1, and review_status. Use the supplied [PDF page N] markers for exact page traceability. Preserve the exact regulatory meaning, never invent clauses, and set review_required whenever classification or page traceability is uncertain or confidence is below 0.85.'},{role:'user',content:'Document: '+$json.title+'
Version: '+$json.version_label+'
Source URL: '+$json.document_url+'
Extract all numbered regulatory clauses from the complete PDF text below.

'+$json.document_text}]}) }}
